advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Resolve the tracker path in `forget_identity_mapping` via `rebar`'s config-aware `tracker_dir` rather than hardcoding `.tickets-tracker`, so it cannot diverge from `resolve_mapping`'s view.
evidence: `config.py:95-112` `tracker_dir` resolves via `tracker_dir_override()` (REBAR_TRACKER_DIR) then `load_config(root).tracker.dir`, so the store location is configurable and the hardcoded name can diverge
docstring frames the helper as general-purpose: `"Used to (re-)establish the \"this user has no identity yet\" precondition an inbound-mint oracle needs."`
advisory.finding: `forget_identity_mapping` hardcodes the tracker path as `Path(repo)/".tickets-tracker"`, but `resolve_mapping` (which it calls in the same loop) resolves the tracker location through `config.tracker_dir`, which honors the `REBAR_TRACKER_DIR` env override and `tracker.dir` config. If the store is ever relocated, `resolve_mapping` would return an id while `tracker/identity_id` would not exist, tripping the helper's `is_dir()` AssertionError even though the mapping legitimately resolves. It is safe only because this fixture uses the default layout.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Make `forget_identity_mapping` remove by the actual on-disk directory carrying the mapping (or assert ticket_id==dir-name) rather than assuming `tracker/identity_id` is the directory.
evidence: `identity.py:181`: `_iter_identities` yields `(state.get("ticket_id") or entry, state)` — the id may derive from state, not the directory name
advisory.finding: `forget_identity_mapping` removes an identity's ticket directory via `shutil.rmtree` on the path `tracker / identity_id`, where `identity_id` comes from `resolve_mapping` which returns `state.get('ticket_id') or entry`. If an identity's stored `ticket_id` ever differs from its on-disk directory entry name, the computed path will not exist and the helper raises its 'no ticket directory' AssertionError rather than removing the mapping. The helper implicitly relies on ticket_id == directory-name, which holds for this store but is not asserted by the helper itself.
